column1: # The board's 128 MiB GigaDevice GD5F1GM7UE SPI NAND (spi0.0): 128 KiB blocks of 2048-byte pages, no sub-pages,
# so UBI's VID header takes the second page. Blocks 0-15 are the vendor's, kept verbatim: the CIS (block 0 and its
# copies in 1-9, with the flash parameters and the partition table the boot ROM and the vendor IPL read) and the
# vendor IPL (0x140000, a copy at 0x1A0000), the only DDR init of the chain. The loader region is ours, packed by
# the loader build: the SPL in the two IPL_CUST slots the partition table fixes (0x200000 and 0x260000, three
# blocks each, the SPL in the first), then U-Boot proper twice (A at 0x2C0000, B at 0x380000, six blocks each,
# loaded raw by the SPL with bad-block skipping) and two spare blocks. UBI starts at 0x480000. The first 22 blocks
# (0x0-0x2BFFFF) are programmed without bad-block skipping and checked on read-back: a skipped block would move
# what follows away from the position the partition table names. A loader update rewrites the whole loader region,
# both SPL slots included. Tab-separated rows (src/image/flash-layout.ts):
# The vendor region's content is a local build input, not in git (README.md); until the assembly can take it,
# its source is `-` and a flash image of this board must not be programmed.
